title: The 'My Brain Doesn't Write' Reframe Script Bank
howToUse: This is Bonus #3 from your programme: a ready-to-use script bank of seventeen self-coaching prompts, sorted by the exact stuck moment they solve. You don't read this top to bottom — you dog-ear the page for the moment you're in (blank page, rewrite spiral, or post-publish regret) and read the script out loud or type it to yourself before you do anything else. It works because every script redirects the fear using the same psychology that already makes you brilliant on a discovery call — you already know how to hold someone through a stuck moment, and this is you doing that for yourself.
promise: Pick the script that matches your exact stuck moment and read it aloud — once — before you write a single word. You'll move from frozen to typing in under three minutes, using only your own voice.

tools.instructions: Fill this in the moment you open a new document and feel nothing — it takes four minutes and gives you the first two sentences of your copy before you close it.
tools.content:
